card.fires_on: The word "in" inside the cross-reference "[see Use in Specific Populations (8.4)]", usually after pediatric dosing statements. Also a space after "Greater than" in age-range dosing tables.

card.writes: It pushes toward age words such as younger, elderly, age and their Chinese equivalents, which fits the age-group heading that follows.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text points to the section on age groups and special populations.
